comparison.objective: Free a disc from a game case, orient it upright, and insert it into a slot-loading console.
comparison.physical_skill: Hub release, thin-disc extraction, reorientation, precision slot alignment, insertion, and handoff to a drive.
comparison.success_condition: Disc enters within 10 degrees of upright, centred within 2.5 mm laterally and 12 mm vertically, reaches 7 cm depth, and is drawn in; touching the table zeros the run. Scratch or bending thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Thin-object release and precision slot insertion do not exercise granular-flow separation, agitation, or selective retention.
